svg.title: Ball screw selection chart
svg.text: Ball screw selection – allowed speed (0.8 · n_c) and allowed buckling load (0.5 · P_k) vs bearing span
Root diameters (example): Ø40 × 20 → d_r 34 mm, Ø50 × 20 → d_r 44 mm – take d_r from the datasheet
Result: speed (critical speed + DN 125 000) and life decide on the HMC; buckling has a big margin
with fixed–fixed mounting. Guide 12, M4.3 – M4.4.
